# i18n — No Hardcoded Static Text

This project supports **English (`en`) and Turkish (`tr`)**. Every string visible to the user **must** come from the translation system.

## Setup

- Library: `i18next` + `react-i18next`
- Hook: `useTranslation` from `react-i18next`
- Config: `src/i18n/index.ts`
- Locale files: `src/locales/{en,tr}/{namespace}.json`

## Namespaces

| Namespace | File          | Use for                            |
| --------- | ------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `common`  | `common.json` | Shared UI (buttons, status, nav…)  |
| `auth`    | `auth.json`   | Login, signup, password reset      |
| `portal`  | `portal.json` | Patient portal pages               |
| `doctor`  | `doctor.json` | Doctor dashboard and related pages |
| `admin`   | `admin.json`  | Admin panel pages                  |

## Rules

1. **Never hardcode user-visible text** in JSX/TSX — no raw string literals inside elements or attributes.
2. Always call `useTranslation` with the appropriate namespace at the top of the component.
3. Use `t('key')` for the default namespace or `t('namespace:key')` to cross-reference another namespace.
4. When adding a new string, add the key to **both** `en` and `tr` locale files simultaneously.
5. Use nested keys to group related strings (e.g. `dashboard.title`, `dashboard.subtitle`).
6. For dynamic values, use i18next interpolation: `t('key', { name: user.name })` with `{{name}}` in the JSON.
7. Plurals must use i18next plural suffixes: `key_one`, `key_other`.

## Examples

```tsx
// CORRECT
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next'

export function SaveButton() {
  const { t } = useTranslation('common')
  return <button>{t('actions.save')}</button>
}

// Cross-namespace reference
const { t } = useTranslation()
<p>{t('admin:dashboard.userManagementTitle')}</p>

// WRONG — never do this
<button>Save</button>
<input placeholder="Search..." />
<p>Welcome to the dashboard</p>
```

## Locale file structure

```json
// src/locales/en/common.json  AND  src/locales/tr/common.json must both be updated
{
  "actions": {
    "save": "Save" // en
    // "save": "Kaydet"     // tr equivalent
  }
}
```

## Checklist before finishing any component

- [ ] `useTranslation` imported and called with the correct namespace
- [ ] No raw string literals in JSX (including `placeholder`, `aria-label`, `title`, `alt`)
- [ ] New translation keys added to both `en` and `tr` locale files
- [ ] Dynamic values use interpolation, not string concatenation
